=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2403-2412 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The heal_issue_failed_itself escalation guard only fires when `DUPLICATE_MATCH` is `fingerprint`. A phase_failure on heal issue N that matches N by cause (budget_decision, scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5810) therefore only posts an occurrence and exits 0, with no ESCALATED_LABEL and no CRITICAL Telegram message.
  WHY: With WORKFLOW_HEAL_CAUSE_GROUPING_ENABLED=true, a heal issue whose own pipeline keeps failing is never handed to a human, and each retry adds another occurrence comment. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: also accept `[ "${DUPLICATE_MATCH}" = "cause" ]` in the guard.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:2077-2309 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_heal_scope_recovery_evaluate`, the recovery re-run copies BUDGET_ARGS and replaces only `--issues-json`. The `--cause`/`--cause-window-days` pair added at lines 2080-2084 passes through, so any unrelated open heal issue with the same cause makes the re-run return duplicate/cause, and the `recovery_action != open` check skips recovery with reason=budget_duplicate.
  WHY: With grouping on, heal-scope recovery (#7191) silently stops working. The occurrence lands on the markerless issue, which can never be implemented, and no replacement is opened. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. Suggested fix: strip `--cause`/`--cause-window-days` and their values from recovery_budget_args.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:9921-9932 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `_cmd_compose_occurrence`, an `OSError` while reading `--signature-file` sets `signature = None` and logs nothing. The sibling evidence-pack branch prints `WORKFLOW_HEAL warn evidence_pack_unreadable`.
  WHY: The cause-match occurrence comment is posted without the required "Error signature" line, and the workflow log gives no reason. All reviewers rated it NIT. Suggested fix: print `WORKFLOW_HEAL warn signature_unreadable` to stderr.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:5748 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The cause window expression in budget_decision (and in `_cmd_budget` at line 9649) falls back to 3 for values above 30 or non-int values. The intake header, docstring, agents fragment and changelog all say the window is "clamped 1..30".
  WHY: WORKFLOW_HEAL_CAUSE_GROUPING_DAYS=45 silently gives a 3-day window, which contradicts the documented range. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:1959-2012 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Filesystem failures in `_heal_cause_key` (`mkdir -p` or the `printf` to signature.txt, ENOSPC/EACCES) return 1. The call-site wrapper then logs the same `cause outcome=skipped reason=helper_failed` it uses for python3 helper failures.
  WHY: Filesystem exhaustion and helper logic errors look the same in logs, yet they need different remediation. Both reviewers rated it NIT.
- tests/test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py:121-127, tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py:28-88 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The pre-push gate says this change caused failures in `test_label_contract_and_reporter_skip` and the checkout integration-ref audit. Static checks contradict this: the provider_unavailable line at intake.sh:1865 still comes before `# --- Fingerprint` at 1870, and workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml is already on the allowlist at audit line 62. CI on the head is unresolved (0 failed, 9 incomplete, collection timeout).
  WHY: The attribution is unverified either way, so both tests need a re-run on the head before merge. Severity disagreement: minimax rated it NIT and glm rated it MAJOR, so the highest is used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A new report with no `fp` match but a `cause` match on an open heal issue created within `WORKFLOW_HEAL_CAUSE_GROUPING_DAYS` ... becomes an occurrence on that heal."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh::_heal_cause_key
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `_heal_cause_key` skips every `SOURCE_KIND` except `workflow_run` and `phase_failure` (lines 1957-1960). Other report kinds, including `autofix_failure` and `validation_failure`, never compute a cause key or add a cause marker, so they cannot take part in grouping.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:line 2403 (guard); related scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py budget_decision, line 5810 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: heal_issue_failed_itself escalation fires only on a fingerprint match. A heal issue N whose own clarify/plan run fails with the same shape but different error lines reaches the cause branch (duplicate/cause, existing_issue=N), so it gets an occurrence with no ESCALATED_LABEL and no CRITICAL Telegram message.
  WHY: With grouping on, this becomes a silent loop that never escalates. With the switch off, a new heal issue opens instead, which is visible. Fix: also accept `[ "${DUPLICATE_MATCH}" = "cause" ]`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:`_heal_scope_recovery_evaluate`, lines 2291-2309; related lines 2080-2083 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The recovery re-run keeps `--cause` and its window. After a fingerprint duplicate on markerless X, the re-run drops X, matches another same-cause issue Y as duplicate/cause, and logs `heal_scope_recovery outcome=skip reason=budget_duplicate`. The occurrence then lands on X.
  WHY: Heal-scope recovery (#7191) breaks with grouping on, so the switch changes behaviour it was not meant to change. Fix: skip `--cause`/`--cause-window-days` with their values, about 4 lines.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:`_cmd_compose_occurrence` (`except OSError: signature = None`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: An unreadable signature file is dropped silently, unlike the evidence-pack branch, which logs a warning.
  WHY: The occurrence is posted without the required "Error signature" line and the log does not say why. Fix: print `WORKFLOW_HEAL warn signature_unreadable`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:budget_decision line 5748 and `_cmd_budget` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Window values above 30 fall back to 3 instead of clamping to 30, as the intake header and agents.d/heal-cause-grouping.md say.
  WHY: Setting WORKFLOW_HEAL_CAUSE_GROUPING_DAYS=45 gives a 3-day window with no log line.
- (informational) The pre-push gate failures were judged not to trace to the diff, so they are not reported as defects. The label_contract.v1.json file is missing from the checkout, the ordering assertion holds, and the intake workflow is already on the audit allowlist (line 62). Both tests still need a re-run on the PR head (0 failed, 9 incomplete).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS (4 related items): change the line 2403 guard to fingerprint||cause (1 line); skip cause args in the recovery_budget_args loop at lines 2292-2300 (4 lines); add a signature_unreadable warn (1 line); at budget_decision line 5748 the `bool` subclass lets `cause_window_days=True` give a 1-day window, so use `type(...) is int` plus `min(max(v,1),30)` or align the docs (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
